pages.title: After the Silence
pages.text: The Listener is gone, and you are an $(l)Archmage$(). That is not the end of what magic can do.$(br2)$(li)An $(l)aura$() in your school's colour$(li)$(l)Legendary forms$() of six signature spells$(li)The $(l)Echo of the Listener$(), to fight again$(li)The $(l)Archmage's Staff$(), which grows with you

pages.title: The Aura
pages.text: Motes of light circle every Archmage. Their colour follows the school of the last spell you cast: violet for General, ember for Elemental, blue for Warding, gold for Divination, green for Nature, deep purple for Forbidden.$(br2)Type $(l)/hollowmancy aura$() to hide or show yours.

pages.title: Legendary Forms
pages.text: Raise a school's signature spell to $(l)tier IV$() and, as an Archmage, it becomes legendary:$(br2)$(li)$(l)Spark$(): Storm Crown. Lightning leaps to 4 more enemies.$(li)$(l)Firebolt$(): Phoenix Volley. A second, wider wave of fire.$(li)$(l)Aegis$(): Bastion. Every ally within 8 blocks is warded too.

$(li)$(l)Reveal$(): All-Seeing. Every revealed enemy is Marked and takes 25% more damage.$(li)$(l)Wellspring$(): Font of Life. Regeneration II for every friend within 10 blocks, and poison cleared.$(li)$(l)Void Lance$(): Singularity. Where the lance ends, a rift drags enemies in for 3 seconds.

pages.title: Silent Seal
pages.text: Every Archmage is given one. Offer it at the Unmaking circle, in the Hollow, to call the $(l)Echo of the Listener$().

pages.name: Ritual of Echoes
pages.text: The same circle as the Unmaking. Archmage, 400 mana, a Silent Seal.

pages.title: The Echo
pages.text: What the Listener left behind, and worse: twice its strength, harder armour, heavier blows. It calls $(l)Hollow Shades$() to its side the whole fight, faster as it weakens.$(br2)Silence it and it drops an $(l)Echo Heart$() and a new Silent Seal, so you can call it again.

pages.title: Echo Heart
pages.text: Still faintly listening. Infuse it to make the Archmage's Staff.

pages.name: Infusion: Archmage's Staff
pages.text: Archmage, 400 mana. Offer an Echo Heart.

pages.title: Archmage's Staff
pages.text: The finest focus: spells cost $(l)40% less$(), gather half the corruption and recharge 10% faster. Like any wand it grows with use, five times.
